subtitles.text: “On the Shore of the Gegham Sea”

about: Lake Sevan, the Gegham Sea, lies about 1,900 metres up in the Armenian highlands. The piece opens with soft, free solo lines in the winds before the full band enters.
note: Lake Sevan, the Gegham Sea, lies about 1,900 metres up in the Armenian highlands. The piece opens with soft, free solo lines in the winds before the full band enters.
